name: android-dev
description: Android development plugin: Gradle build management, a per-stage on-device verify gate (build the debug APK, detect an adb device, install + smoke-launch + run instrumented tests), UI design verified by a screenshot-grading evaluator loop (emulator captures scored against a weighted design rubric by a separate evaluator), multi-device emulator orchestration via MCP, automated screenshot capture across phone and tablet form factors, release signing, and publishing for F-Droid and Google Play.
